engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

researchNotes.thesis: Global high-chrome mill internals bottleneck supplier to cement and mining industries with >20% ROCE and net-cash balance sheet.
researchNotes.evidenceLocator: Prolonged mining capex freeze, anti-dumping duties in key export jurisdictions, or permanent loss of grinding-media conversion share.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

researchNotes.author: hamsa-analyst
researchNotes.thesis: Travel-tech SaaS and DaaS platform compounding revenue at 47.8% 3Y CAGR with 0.92x 3Y CFO/PAT conversion; experiencing institutional supply clearance.
researchNotes.evidenceLocator: Permanent loss of airline/OTA distribution contracts, AI disintermediation of channel-manager pricing, or value-destructive M&A.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

researchNotes.author: hamsa-analyst
researchNotes.thesis: Private-label value fashion (Zudio/Westside) scaling store footprint with industry-leading inventory turns and self-funded cash conversion.
researchNotes.evidenceLocator: Same-store sales growth (SSSG) deceleration below 5%, store cannibalization across tier-2/3 clusters, or lease-cost inflation.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y sales CAGR > 0.12 AND 3y PAT CAGR > 0.12 AND (ROCE > 12 percentage points OR improving) AND positive sales growth in >=3/4 latest YoY quarters
engineFindings.explanation: Insufficient periods or missing/invalid metrics remain unproven; all input periods must already be point-in-time eligible.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: YoY quarterly sales growth > 0.20 AND (PAT growth > 0.25 OR loss-to-profit) AND same-quarter YoY operating margin improvement
engineFindings.explanation: One-offs and base effects require explicit review; no adjustment is inferred by the engine.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: rising capex/CWIP/gross block AND source-backed commissioning/trial/qualification AND demand/customer evidence
engineFindings.explanation: The engine does not reject capex-heavy businesses because of current ROCE or FCF. Narrative evidence gates need cited human review.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: 3y cumulative CFO/PAT >= 0.8 AND (positive FCF in >=2/3 years OR documented expansion explains negative FCF)
engineFindings.explanation: PAT/CFO divergence, receivables, inventory, and any expansion explanation remain visible research checks.

engineFindings.calculationExpression: volume multiple >= explicitly configured threshold OR venue-specific delivery percentage-point change >= explicitly configured threshold; AND separately evidenced forced/structural selling AND absorption capacity
engineFindings.explanation: Block/bulk, ownership, lock-in, pledge and absorption evidence must be separately sourced; delivery remains venue-specific.
